title: Find your quest givers
changes: When a new quest is waiting, the tracker now says where its giver stands and its follow button leads you there.
The waygate to Act 2 is now on the map, just outside Oakvale's south gate. Once it wakes, the tracker sends you through it to Captain Rakhim in Kel Ashar.
The quest log tells you where each quest giver is, and which bosses you still need to beat to open the desert.
